lede: Pali And Thai accounts for 28 catalogued manuscripts, 3 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Rai (32% of the corpus for this language), ahead of Phayao and Nan. Nearly all (86%) are written in Thai · อักษรไทย script. By support it leans to khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (39%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (29%). Dated witnesses run 1742–2007 CE (20 of 28 carry a date).
